name: PictoGlyph Master Source Discovery Catalogue
scope: Research institutions and existing project sources identified for ancient writing, symbols, and contextual data. Not an exhaustive list of every collection worldwide.
not_executable: Discovery catalogue only. Do not pass directly to download_sources.py or run_source_list.py or auto-download all sources.

selection_policy.uk_research_basis: UK Copyright, Designs and Patents Act section 29A may permit copies for computational analysis for non-commercial research where access is lawful and acknowledgment is sufficient; this does not authorise bypassing access controls or public redistribution.
before_download: Check lawful access and any applicable terms, access mechanisms and rate limits
Confirm a machine-readable endpoint exists or secure permission for bulk access
Keep item-level rights, attribution, provenance and retrieval dates
Do not circumvent authentication, CAPTCHAs or technical restrictions
Do not assume item with an image link has a sign image or verified label
recommended_ingestion: Filter script and inscription relevance using object metadata
Inspect image licence and research use basis
Acquire selected image and preserve URL/IIIF manifest plus checksum
Apply throttling, retries, checkpoints and per-source progress
